entities.name: Human
entities.description: A species of four-limbed bipedal primates found on nearly every plane, and the characteristic species of the color white.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane of five shards on which humans were the only species native to all five.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: An Alaran shard whose humans are regal, caste-bound and devoted to a rigid code of honor.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: An Alaran shard whose humans are etherium-enhanced mages ruled by the most powerful among them.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: An Alaran shard where the few living humans, who call themselves Vithians, hide from undead.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: An Alaran shard where fierce human tribes live beneath dragons.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: An Alaran shard whose humans are pleasure-loving jungle dwellers.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event that merged the Alaran shards; half of the Riftclan Tol Breot was transported to Grixis during it.

entities.name: Vithians
entities.description: The name Grixis's humans call themselves, after the kingdom of the living they still attempt to sustain.

entities.name: Highclan Tol Hera
entities.description: A small Jund human tribe led by Javid Hera that wants to wage ongoing war against the dragons and consumes sangrite.

entities.name: Javid Hera
entities.description: The impetuous leader of the Jund human tribe Highclan Tol Hera.

entities.name: Sunseeders
entities.description: Naya humans who build settlements in open spaces and pursue an agrarian revolution.

entities.name: Hadran
entities.description: A charismatic man who leads the Sunseeders of Naya.

entities.name: Exuberants
entities.description: Hedonistic Naya humans who live in the small jungle cities and host competitions.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane whose humans are the only race not associated with one of the five gods.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane where humans are the earliest known inhabitants.

entities.name: Primeval Dragons
entities.description: Cruel and powerful dragons who once ruled the earliest humans of Terisiare.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: The base of the large empire formed by humans after they overthrew the Primeval Dragons.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane whose humans grew organic metal pieces on their bodies and were divided into five tribes.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who launched an initial assault on Mirrodin that its divided tribes could not resist.

entities.name: Crephas
entities.description: A ruler of Cridhe who, before his madness, engineered the Albions to work his coal mines and later enslaved them.

entities.name: Albions
entities.description: Cridhe humans altered by Crephas's fungus, addicted to it, blue-skinned and large-eyed, and feared by the general population.

entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: A plane where Crephas engineered the Albions.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A plane with blasted plains inhabited by the human Vec and Dal tribes.

entities.name: Vec
entities.description: The nomadic human tribe of Rath.

entities.name: Dal
entities.description: The settled human tribe of Rath.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose humans live longer than humans elsewhere and are the only species with many members in all guilds.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane where humans are the main sentient species, preyed upon by vampires and werewolves.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane where humans are the only remaining sentient species and live in sanctuaries.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane whose humans first appeared in its core as the Komon Winaq.

entities.name: Komon Winaq
entities.description: The first humans of Ixalan, who founded the Oltec civilization and later the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane whose humans live in the realm of Bretagard in five clans.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: A plane where most humans live in the Realm and some in the Wilds.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose humans are resourceful but ragged from ongoing conflict.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane whose humans are inventive dreamers untouched physically by aether.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: A plane whose humanoid races, humans included, emerged at the end of the Dawning Age.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Listed as a notable human.

events.summary: Humans on Dominaria overthrow their cruel draconic masters, the Primeval Dragons, and form a large empire based in Otaria.
events.quote: These people overthrew their draconic masters and formed a large empire based in Otaria

events.summary: Crephas engineers the Albions with an altered fungus to work his coal mines, and they become addicted and turn blue.
events.quote: He served the altered fungus to his best soldiers, increasing their capacity for work and their ability to see in near darkness.

events.summary: Crephas chooses to enslave the Mirkalbions, binding them to himself.
events.quote: He chose to enslave them, binding them to himself.

events.summary: Half of the Riftclan Tol Breot is transported to Grixis during the Conflux.
events.quote: Half the clan was transported to Grixis during the Conflux .

events.summary: Grixis's humans are near extinction by the time of the Conflux.
events.quote: but were near extinction by the time of the Conflux

events.summary: The Phyrexians launch their initial assault on Mirrodin and its divided tribes fall one after another, the Morioks first.
events.quote: The Morioks fell first, followed by the Neuroks, and finally the Sylvoks.

events.summary: Only the Aurioks and Vulshoks hold some ground against the Phyrexians, and their populations are still decimated.
events.quote: Only the Aurioks and Vulshoks managed to hold any of their ground, and their populations were still decimated.

events.summary: The desert wizard Karli summons flying men to attack Gull and Greensleeves in 4074 AR.
events.quote: The desert wizard Karli summoned a group of flying men to attack Gull and Greensleeves in 4074 AR .

relations.note: A charismatic man leads the Sunseeders.
relations.quote: Led by a charismatic man named Hadran

relations.note: The impetuous Javid Hera leads the tribe.
relations.quote: led by the impetuous Javid Hera

relations.note: He engineered the Albions to work the coal mines.
relations.quote: it caused him to engineer the Albions to work the coal mines

relations.note: Humans were their cruel subjects and overthrew them.
relations.quote: the subjects of the cruel and powerful Primeval Dragons
